findings.issue: MAX on characters was marked unobservable
findings.resolution: 7.4.4.4 guarantees letters in alphabetical order, digits in numeric order and blank first, so MAX('A','B') == 'B', MAX('1','9') == '9' and blank extension are portable

findings.issue: MAXLOC on characters, the same over-suppression
findings.resolution: guaranteed-order pairs with BACK= tie cases

findings.issue: MAXEXPONENT was recorded as wholly unobservable
findings.resolution: the value is latitude, but EXPONENT(HUGE(x)) == MAXEXPONENT(x) is an exact portable relation
